sikka.definition: The exclusive right to stamp a ruler's name on minted coin - one of the two classical markers of sovereignty in Islamic political theory (alongside the khutba, having one's name invoked in the Friday sermon). Usurping it was a real act of political rebellion, not a formality.

muhtasib.definition: A market inspector, responsible for weights, measures, and honest dealing in the bazaar under Islamic law - the legitimate oversight that quarters like the one Rostam operates in exist specifically to stay outside of.
